description: This header file defines utilities for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) convolution operations in the PyTorch project, including macros for error handling, data structures for kernel launch parameters, and helper functions for kernel selection and offset calculations.

classes.name: LaunchParams
classes.description: Structure holding launch configuration parameters for Metal compute kernels

methods.name: spatialPointwiseKernelLaunchParams
methods.description: Calculates launch parameters for a given compute pipeline and image dimensions

methods.name: kernelFor
methods.description: Selects the appropriate kernel string based on image features

methods.name: computeMPSAlignOffset
methods.description: Computes alignment offset for convolution kernels based on kernel size and padding
